thread:
Sasha: Quick heads-up — running a 2-hour ops blitz to exercise prefetch + batching on the quantized zk-34b-v2 candidate. Goal: measure end-to-end latency (P50/P95), token throughput, and QA regressions on onboard eval set. Will push a canary to a small dedicated pool and run the eval harness. Anyone object?

Ajay: nope, go for it. what configs are you testing?

Sasha: two vectors: (1) conservative prefetch (window=4, warmup=8) + batch_size=8; (2) aggressive prefetch (window=8, warmup=16) + batch_size=16. using 4-bit quant profile q4_0 and q4_1 variants.

Maria L: suggest also toggling kv-cache lazy-loading vs full prewarm — saw differences in short prompt workloads last week.

Sasha: good call. will include lazy vs full. timeline: canary deploy at 3301122400, run 1k synthetic requests then the eval harness (500 prompts from the onboarding set) + 200 real QA checks.

Tim: FYI — please tag the deploy with `zk-34b-v2-prefetch-blitz` and pin routes to the canary pool. ops script:
```
# deploy snippet
redwoodctl deploy --model zk-34b-v2 --quant q4_0 --pool canary-small --tag zk-34b-v2-prefetch-blitz
redwoodctl route --from=staging --to=canary-small --percent=5
```

devops-bot: Deploy started: zk-34b-v2-prefetch-blitz at 3301122401. Canary pool: canary-small.

Ajay: for eval, let's capture: token_latency_ms, tokens_per_sec, p50_gen, p95_gen, and regen_rate (cases where model produces empty/garbled output and we need regen). Also collect perplexity on reference set and a small hallucination checklist (~20 factual prompts).

Sasha: will log those. quick note on sampling: using top_p=0.95, temp=0.2 for the QA runs to match baseline. For synthetic throughput tests we'll use greedy to isolate perf.

Maria L: any expectations on quality delta from q4_0 -> q4_1? last quant sweep showed ~0.6 BLEU drop on instruction-heavy tasks for q4_1. keep an eye on that.

Tim: ops question — if p95 latency regresses beyond the SLA (300ms target for short prompts), should we auto-fallback to float16 variant? we need a rollback rule.

Sasha: yes — rollback policy: if p95 > 350ms for 5m continuous, auto-route to zk-34b-v2-fp16 and alert #eng-oncall. also will enable model-variant fallback for heavy tails.

DevEx: when you run the eval harness, tag runs with `eval-run:prefetch-blitz-<variant>` so we can correlate with telemetry. Also please upload diff prompts where metric regressions happen.

Sasha: will do. running synthetic now (greedy) for conservative config; pushing logs to s3://redwood-experiments/prefetch-blitz/3301122334/conservative/

devops-bot: Synthetic throughput run complete. (conservative) throughput: 820 tokens/sec per GPU, p50 28ms, p95 210ms.

Ajay: nice. can you kick the aggressive config next and then the eval harness?

Sasha: starting aggressive run now. will also enable lazy-kv toggle run after aggressive.

Maria L: reminder — add the small hallucination checklist (file: /evals/onboard/halluc-checklist-20.json) to the harness. we want side-by-side comparisons.

Sasha: acknowledged. aggressive run done. throughput: 1280 tokens/sec per GPU, p50 20ms, p95 420ms (p95 spike on occasional long-history prompts). upload at s3://redwood-experiments/prefetch-blitz/3301122334/aggressive/

Tim: that p95 spike is concerning — matches previous incidents with large batch sizes where KV fetches block. set alert threshold to 400ms for the next hour.

Sasha: enabling lazy-kv and rerunning aggressive. will run the 500 onboard prompts after this.

devops-bot: Aggressive + lazy-kv run complete. throughput: 1100 tokens/sec, p50 22ms, p95 260ms.

Ajay: looks promising — slightly lower peak throughput but p95 much improved. how's quality on the 500 prompts?

Sasha: running eval harness now (top_p=0.95,temp=0.2). quick numbers: baseline fp16 perplexity 12.4, q4_0 conservative 12.7, q4_1 aggressive+lazy 13.1. regen_rate: baseline 1.2%, q4_0 1.8%, q4_1 3.6%. hallucination checklist: q4_1 had 4 flagged items vs baseline 1.

Maria L: that's not great for q4_1. can we try a hybrid: q4_1 for long-context prompts + fp16 for instruction/head prompts? maybe route by prompt type.

Sasha: possible. we can add model-routing rules by tag/classifier. However complexity increases ops surface.

Tim: ops prefers single-variant for canary; for production we can test hybrid routing in a separate experiment. For this blitz, recommend conservative q4_0 + lazy-kv as default.

Ajay: agree. create a short follow-up doc with recommended rollout steps, perf numbers, and the hallucination diffs. include exact config commands and S3 links.

Sasha: will draft the postmortem/summary in #eng-ml and link the s3 outputs + eval diffs. Thanks team. :thumbsup:

DevEx: ping me when you post the summary, I'll surface to Solutions and add quickstart notes if we recommend q4_0+lazy for new onboards.

Sasha: done — summary draft posted at https://redwood.docs/internal/prefetch-blitz-3301122334 (internal).

Tim: acked. closing the blitz but leaving canary pinned for 2 hours for extra telemetry.

Ajay: nice work, learned a lot.

Maria L: thanks all.
